dedupe_keys.name: отчет за изразходваните средства за компенсация от намалени приходи от прилагане на цени за обществени пътнически превози и субсидиране на нерентабилни автобусни линии

description: Отчет за изразходваните средства за компенсация от намалени приходи от прилагане на цени за обществени пътнически превози и субсидиране на нерентабилни автобусни линии is a dataset listed in Open Data Bulgaria, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Мариана Допчева. Statement of funds spent on compensation from reduced revenues from pricing for public passenger transport and subsidisation of unprofitable bus services. Coverage: Мариана Допчева. The portal shows the English title as "Statement of funds spent on compensation from reduced revenues from pricing for public passenger transport and subsidisa" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Мариана Допчева. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-bulgaria.
